newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-McIntosh sees slightly higher profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-McIntosh sees slightly higher profit.

text.p: Listed Australian stockbroker McIntosh Securities Ltd on Tuesday forecast it would post a net profit of at least A$11 million for the year to June 30, 1997, up from A$10.1 million a year earlier.

"Our profit for 1995/96 (to June 30) was A$10.1 million and our budget for the current year is A$11 million ... given current trading conditions, we are presently forecasting that we will achieve our budget for the full year," chairman John McIntosh told the annual meeting.
Earlier on Tuesday, McIntosh said it had agreed to a A$1.40 per share takeover bid by Merrill Lynch and Co Inc, valuing the company at about A$117 million.
McIntosh shares closed at A$1.38, up 13 cents from Friday's close.
McIntosh characterised the reaction of its 20 percent shareholder, ING Bank, to the bid news during talks today as "friendly."
"ING have yet to establish their position. My guess is that in the end that they will accept," he added.
